paragraphs: GoApron sells cloud-based software that airports use to automate gate utilization, aircraft parking, and the rates and charges attached to them. The airlines and ground handlers that share the apron work in the same system, requesting gates and remote spots instead of phoning or emailing for them. It is meant to be used away from a desk as well as at one.

Gates and aircraft parking spots are assigned in advance or on demand, and usage is tracked through automated scheduling. Gate and remote parking schedules can be viewed and changed in real time. The same records feed billing, with monthly airline charges calculated and reconciled from actual per-turn use. Landings that previously went uncaptured are recorded, along with landing weight totals and RON tracking.

The company describes an industry where planes are still parked using pen, paper, fax, spreadsheets and PDFs. Airfield operations specialists, it says, lose day and night shift hours to calls from airlines and ground handlers. GoApron says it offers airline partners gates and spots based on preferential use, aircraft size, operational rules and real-time data.

quote.text: GoApron helps airports park airplanes smarter, save time, forecast scheduling, and increase revenue
